protocol.interpretation: Frozen exploratory pilot before outcomes: four families x Rest/no-Rest actual lead kit x four paired seeds; two on-pool control pairs. Explicit legal full teams from catalog; change only an unselected level to force unknown preview; fixed legal picks/first actions. Evaluated side uses production EarlyPerish or opt-in EarlyRest; common opponent stays production EarlyPerish. Keep copied-move and HP experimental behavior unchanged/off. Common battle/search seeds and alternating side. Caps stay unknown, report Rest and no-Rest separately. No adoption from coverage. Positive pilot must pass fresh confirmation, using the previously accepted 80% model-conditional improvement probability criterion with prior sensitivity and non-recovery controls; not a human-superiority claim.
protocol.candidate: Preserve EarlyPerish draw where present. For an appeared living fallback mon whose model lacks Rest and has a free or unrevealed slot, sample a Rest-inserted alternative with weight equal to compatible fixed-pool Rest source weight; retain baseline with remaining compatible weight. Compatibility checks species, public item presence/original item, revealed moves, level-legal complete source moves. No source DV/stats/item transfer; observed moves immutable. No compatible source or no Rest support is identity. Default remains EarlyPerish.
